name: [Pair] Deep Dive Plug Suit Asuka & Mari

sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Awakening. (Activates for 60 seconds when HP reaches 60% or below.)
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 60% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 60% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 20 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 20 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 12000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 12000
